body: Claude profile endpoint GET https://api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/profile (same OAuth auth) returns organization.{organization_type, rate_limit_tier, billing_type, subscription_status, subscription_created_at}; no renewal date or interval. /api/oauth/subscription is 404; /api/organizations/<org>/subscription_details rejects OAuth tokens. Used by `agx plan` (v0.3.0, 2026-09-26).
